classes.name: XCAFNoteObjects_NoteObject
classes.summary: object to store note auxiliary data

instanceMethods.name: HasPlane
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if plane is specified.

instanceMethods.name: GetPlane
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a right-handed coordinate system of the plane.

instanceMethods.name: SetPlane
instanceMethods.comment: Sets a right-handed coordinate system of the plane.

instanceMethods.name: HasPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the attachment point on the annotated object is specified.

instanceMethods.name: GetPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the attachment point on the annotated object.

instanceMethods.name: SetPoint
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the anchor point on the annotated object.

instanceMethods.name: HasPointText
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the text position is specified.

instanceMethods.name: GetPresentation
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a tessellated annotation if specified.

instanceMethods.name: Reset
instanceMethods.comment: Resets data to the state after calling the default constructor.
